description: Source code for the Kubernetes EndpointSlice Mirroring Controller, managing mirroring of Endpoints to EndpointSlices, including event handling, synchronization, and cleanup logic.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main controller struct managing EndpointSlice mirroring, event handling, and synchronization.

methods.name: NewController
methods.description: Factory function to create and initialize a new Controller instance with informers, event handlers, and configuration.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller, event processing, worker threads, and manages shutdown.

methods.name: worker
methods.description: Worker thread function that processes items from the queue.

methods.name: processNextWorkItem
methods.description: Processes a single item from the queue, handling errors and retries.

methods.name: handleErr
methods.description: Handles errors during processing, implementing retry logic and dropping items after max retries.

methods.name: syncEndpoints
methods.description: Main synchronization logic for a given Endpoints resource, including cleanup and reconciliation.

methods.name: queueEndpoints
methods.description: Enqueues an Endpoints resource for processing based on its key.

methods.name: shouldMirror
methods.description: Determines if an Endpoints resource should be mirrored based on labels and annotations.

methods.name: onServiceAdd
methods.description: Event handler for Service addition, queues related Endpoints if needed.

methods.name: onServiceUpdate
methods.description: Event handler for Service updates, queues related Endpoints if selector state changes.

methods.name: onServiceDelete
methods.description: Event handler for Service deletion, queues related Endpoints if needed.

methods.name: onEndpointsAdd
methods.description: Event handler for Endpoints addition, queues for mirroring if applicable.

methods.name: onEndpointsUpdate
methods.description: Event handler for Endpoints update, queues for mirroring if applicable.

methods.name: onEndpointsDelete
methods.description: Event handler for Endpoints deletion, queues for cleanup if applicable.

methods.name: onEndpointSliceAdd
methods.description: Event handler for EndpointSlice addition, queues related Endpoints if managed by this controller.

methods.name: onEndpointSliceUpdate
methods.description: Event handler for EndpointSlice updates, queues related Endpoints if labels or management status changed.

methods.name: onEndpointSliceDelete
methods.description: Event handler for EndpointSlice deletion, queues related Endpoints if managed by this controller.

methods.name: queueEndpointsForEndpointSlice
methods.description: Queues the Endpoints resource related to a specific EndpointSlice.

methods.name: deleteMirroredSlices
methods.description: Deletes EndpointSlices mirrored for a specific Endpoints resource.

methods.name: endpointSlicesMirroredForService
methods.description: Returns EndpointSlices mirrored for a specific Service.
